def all_even(xs: list[int]) -> list[int] fail Bad:
    """Check every element of xs in parallel and return them unchanged when all are even.
    When some element is odd, fail with the Bad of the lowest-index odd element,
    regardless of which parallel call finishes first."""

    ex all_even([2, 4, 6]) == [2, 4, 6]
    ex all_even([2, 3, 5]) == Err(Bad(n=3))

    for x, r in zip(xs, results):

            fail Bad(n=x)
    out: list[int] = []
    for r in results:
        out.append(r)
    return out
